reader.requirement: At --std 85 the REPORT clause of a report file's FD is the clause of XIII.3.3 (REPORT IS / REPORTS ARE report-name-1 ...): admitted among the 1985 report FD clauses (BLOCK, RECORD, LABEL, VALUE OF, CODE-SET) in any order, its report-names bound to the RDs, with its syntax rules enforced.

edition-consulted.switches: LABEL RECORDS (and the other DeletedAt2002 rows of FileDescriptionFormats.Rows) admitted in the report FD at 85, refused COBOL0902 from 2002

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel in FileDescriptionFormats.cs and ResolveReports: none; the only edition switch is the removal gate of the COBOL-85 FD clauses
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the 1985 report FD also admits LABEL RECORDS / VALUE OF beside the REPORT clause; at 2023 LABEL RECORDS is refused COBOL0902
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1050 covers REPORTS ARE with two names; clause order, REPORTS without ARE, the 1985-only FD clauses beside REPORT and the SR1/SR2/SR3 refusals are not exercised (probed here)

probes.printed: runs: [AAA 1 ] [BBB 1 ] [BBB 2 ] [AAA 2 ] with REPORTS ARE first, CODE-SET, LABEL RECORDS STANDARD, VALUE OF FILE-ID, RECORD, BLOCK
--std 2023 compile: error COBOL0902: the LABEL RECORDS clause was removed in COBOL-2002
probes.expected: later edition refuses the 85-only clause (contrast arm)

probes.printed: error COBOL2604: the LINAGE clause ... is not a clause of Format 3 (report) of the file description entry
probes.expected: LINAGE is not in the 1985 report FD format: refusal

probes.printed: error COBOL2714: the REPORT clause names 'R-C', which is not the subject of a report description entry
error COBOL2714: the REPORT clause names 'R-A', which is already named by the REPORT clause of file 'PRT'
error COBOL2578: file description entry 'PRT' specifies a REPORT clause and has 1 record description
error COBOL2371: OPEN INPUT 'PRT' — a report file shall not be opened INPUT or I-O

probes.expected: ARE is optional in the format: accepted

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.2.4 GR4  (3.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: GR4 is a cross-reference to the REPORT clause; the clause is parsed by reportClause, admitted only in Format 3 by FileDescriptionFormats.Rows, and its syntax rules are enforced at 85. The diagnostics at 85 cite §2023 clauses (COBOL2604 lists the 2023 Format 3 clause set, omitting LABEL/VALUE OF that 85 admits); the verdicts are right, the citations are another edition's.

refuter.evidence: GR4 is only a pointer ('The REPORT clause is presented on page XIII-9') and the REPORT clause works at 85 (reader's probes, plus fd_ext-001 and fd_range-001 ran with REPORTS ARE R-A R-B; fd_rel-001: a RELATIVE report file is refused COBOL2604, §1985:XIII.3.2.3 SR3). SIBLING FINDING (not this rule): the printed page (rendered PDF page 589, folio XIII-7) shows the report FD's RECORD clause with only 'CONTAINS integer-3 CHARACTERS' and 'CONTAINS integer-4 TO integer-5 CHARACTERS', and §1985:XIII.3.2.4 GR3 limits the other clauses to those 'shown on page XIII-7', yet fd_varying-001 (FD PRT RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 1 TO 12 CHARACTERS REPORTS ARE R-A R-B) compiles and runs at --std 85 (under-rejects; at --std 2023 only LABEL RECORDS is refused, so VARYING has no 85 arm). That belongs to the 3.2.2 format / 3.2.4 GR3 row. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.2.4 GR4  (3.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.2.4 GR3  (3.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3'.
